description: Leak-free 70:20:10 (train:val:test, by clean frames) split of Defog_Dataset. Scenes 00-09 are ONE continuous recording: val takes its start (00, 01), test its end (09), train the middle (03-07); one whole scene on each side of train is excluded as a buffer (02 ~75 s, 08 ~75 s), above the 60 s at which ORB+RANSAC place matching across a cut falls to the unrelated-place level. GH019005 (independent GoPro recording) goes to test and the first part of GH019014 to val, so both eval sets contain both cameras; the rest of GH019014 is train, with the 60 s buffer cut automatically between the two parts. GH019007/08/09 are back-to-back GoPro recordings and stay in train. GH019007 drives past the location of val scene 00 again (same buildings/markings; matches around GH019007 frames 6806-8816), so only its frames [0, 5005) are kept.
